title: BlurCords
description: BlurCords is a security-focused mod that automatically censors your coordinates and sensitive data from the debug screen (F3). It's a perfect tool for streamers and players on Anarchy servers to protect their base locations from accidental leaks with just
body:
BlurCords
Keep your base safe from accidental coordinate leaks.

I made BlurCords because accidentally leaking your base on an anarchy server or during a stream is the worst feeling ever. It's a simple, straightforward client-side mod that automatically censors sensitive information on your F3 debug screen.

What it does:

Auto-Censor: Whenever you open the F3 screen, your XYZ, Block, Chunk, Facing, and Biome are instantly blurred out and replaced with "*** BLURCORDS ***".

Toggle Key: Need to check your coords real quick? Just press the M key to reveal the numbers. Press it again to hide them back.

HUD Status: There is a clean, unobtrusive text on the corner of your screen telling you if BlurCords is active, so you're never guessing if you're safe.

Auto-Save: The mod remembers your choice. If you close the game with the coords hidden, they will stay hidden when you log back in.

Why use it?
On no-rules servers, a single screenshot on Discord or a random video frame with F3 open is enough to lose months of grinding. With this mod, even if you press the F3 button by mistake, your location stays an absolute secret.

Technical details:

Modloader: Fabric

Client-Side only: You only need to install it on your PC. It works on any multiplayer server, Realms, or single-player world.

Developed by Gatosmias/MiausDEV. same person
